summary: The note-candidates pass now shows the model each message's moment in the room's own time zone with its weekday (`2026-09-08 Tue 02:13 HKT`) instead of a UTC timestamp, so «this Saturday» resolves against the room's calendar rather than a cross-zone calculation the model had to do with no reasoning budget.
details: Measured against the scenario suite (issue #118): rendered as `2026-09-07 18:13:23 UTC`, the model resolved «今個禮拜六» to the 13th in two of ten samples and missed the note in five more. The weekday and the local day are facts this process has.

`NoteCandidateAdaptor` takes a `timezone` collaborator; composition passes `ZoneInfo([reminders] timezone)` — the same zone the curator's `_today` reads — and the eval seam does the same. `note-candidates.md` is version 3 and tells the model to read the weekday from the line rather than work it out.
Tests: the rendered moment for one instant differs between zones 25 hours apart, through the adaptor and through the composition root.
limitations: The zone is one per deployment (`[reminders] timezone`), not per room; a workspace in another zone renders in the operator's.
